setting: a sunlit asphalt race circuit: smooth dark tarmac with white edge lines and red-white kerbs, tyre barriers, grandstands and advertising boards, green verges and distant hills under a clear sky

subjects.desc: a sleek open-wheel racing kart with a low body, exposed engine and a helmeted driver; the one the camera follows is the player's kart, the others are rival karts in different liveries
subjects.motion: driving exactly along its recorded path

sound: screaming kart engines, tyres squealing on asphalt, crowd noise
